entities.summary: Kina Malpartida Dyson is a Peruvian female professional boxer and National Surfing Champion. She held the World Boxing Association World Title in the Super Featherweight class from February 21, 2009, until October 30, 2013. Malpartida is a member of the International Women's Boxing Hall of Fame.
